scope: All 82 task identifiers from the public prompts-and-metadata preview. Agentic provisional ID; full-release answers and grading rubrics were not accessed.
assessment_scope: All 82 complete public prompts reviewed and manually classified into 27 workflow patterns. External scientific sources, six referenced attachment bundles, biological inputs and native grading rubrics remain uninspected. No solutions were produced.

inventory_completeness.full_release_identity_match: not checked; gated full release not retrieved

license_and_contamination: Public preview is CC-BY-4.0 and explicitly for inspecting distribution and prompts. Do not train on benchmark data. This inventory contains identifiers, prompt hashes and abstract analysis patterns only; prompts, canary text, sequences, molecule structures, answers and rubrics are not copied into training authoring.
input_access: Six questions explicitly reference attachments absent from the preview file listing; external biological databases and papers were not retrieved. All public prompt IDs are enumerated, but input availability is incomplete.
native_scoring: The full dataset card describes LLM-graded outcome and process rubrics. Their implementation and task-specific ground truth were not accessed or executed. Deterministic adaptation requires independently defined artifact contracts.

task_defaults.assessment: Complete public prompt and requested endpoint manually assessed; no benchmark answers or biological fixtures used for authoring.
remaining_gaps: Inspect native input schemas and the underlying scientific evidence; reconcile time cutoffs, missing attachments and unresolved methodological choices.
Use independent observed biological inputs with documented reuse and lineage checks. Keep benchmark prompts, answers and fixtures out of training.
Specify complete intermediate artifacts, deterministic decision rules and negative controls, then validate an offline connected oracle within 30 minutes.

required_stages: define the patient denominator and treatment classes
deduplicate historical patient records
compare proportions under a declared difference rule
scientific_decisions: Patient and event records need distinct denominators; descriptive differences do not establish treatment effects.

required_stages: resolve sequence version and annotated boundaries
track component order and cleavage or tag bookkeeping
check complete sequence or mass outputs
scientific_decisions: A construction endpoint needs separate review before authoring; observed-sequence analysis does not by itself cover engineered constructs.

required_stages: identify the relevant ligand, chain and chemical component
resolve protonation, tautomer and covalent state
export charge, formula or bond-order evidence
scientific_decisions: A deposited chemical component and the bound chemical state may differ; hydrogen placement and pH assumptions must be explicit.

required_stages: map analog identities and structural changes
compare ligand interactions in a specified binding site
rank affinity hypotheses with their evidence
scientific_decisions: A predicted ranking is not measured affinity; an independent deterministic task needs observed affinity evidence or a frozen model and clearly scoped claims.

required_stages: freeze structural database release and inclusion rules
resolve species, methods, chains and sequence variants
export all qualifying structure identities
scientific_decisions: Date cutoff, entity versus chain, mutation count and species mixtures change the eligible structure set.

required_stages: reconcile parent compounds and mechanism identities
join clinical development or regulatory evidence at a date cutoff
export a deduplicated compound table
scientific_decisions: Development phase metadata alone does not establish regulatory approval; alternate forms and targets need explicit deduplication.

required_stages: select the deposited ligand entity or author chain
reconstruct connectivity and stereochemistry under the stated state convention
export a canonical chemical identifier
scientific_decisions: A coordinate fragment, covalent intermediate and free precursor are different chemical objects.

required_stages: resolve molecular connectivity and state
calculate the requested descriptor under pinned definitions
export values or alert identities with units and rounding
scientific_decisions: Pin descriptor definitions, alert catalogs, stereochemistry and ion/adduct conventions; an exact string can hide a wrong molecular identity.

required_stages: freeze gene, target and evidence identifiers
join the required variant, expression, function or bioactivity evidence
apply eligibility, ranking and tie rules
export the selected target and an exclusion ledger
scientific_decisions: Evidence types, accession versions, species and target identity must survive joins; association scores do not establish causal mechanisms.

required_stages: select coordinates, chain, conformer and relevant atoms
apply donor, acceptor, distance and angular criteria
enumerate every qualifying interaction and aggregate it
scientific_decisions: Hydrogen placement, waters, intra/intermolecular contacts and metal coordination need explicit counting rules.

required_stages: align structures and reconcile residue or atom identities
measure local conformations or pocket geometry
export the selected residue, atom or bond with measurements
scientific_decisions: Nearest geometry alone does not prove a chemical modification will improve binding; validation needs a defined geometric decision.

required_stages: resolve canonical sequence and annotated boundaries
apply cleavage and modification rules
export peptide sequence or mass-to-charge values
scientific_decisions: Keep mature-chain boundaries, cleavage exceptions, modification sites and charge conventions explicit.

required_stages: filter dated structure metadata
identify active-site metals and coordinating atoms per chain
aggregate chain-level distances and export provenance
scientific_decisions: Per-chain means and pooled atom means differ; structural-resolution filters do not replace chemical coordination rules.

required_stages: join compound, assay and publication identities
normalize endpoint, relation and units
select and rank eligible measured activities
export complete measurement and provenance rows
scientific_decisions: Censored and exact measurements cannot be ranked interchangeably; replicate and parent-compound aggregation needs a specified rule.

required_stages: freeze the publication version
extract compound identities and assay tables
apply missingness, censoring, ratio or percentile selection
calculate descriptors for the selected structures
scientific_decisions: Quantile definitions, ties and censored values can change the selected compound; structure extraction must be independently checked.

required_stages: link literature-defined biological entities to versioned identifiers
join expression, association and interaction evidence
carry dependent selections into structural or model analysis
export the full decision chain
scientific_decisions: A network association is not causal evidence; every dependent selection and model output needs explicit provenance.

required_stages: join complete paired assay measurements
transform potency into consistent units
fit specified regressions under leave-one-out omissions
compare fit criteria and identify the influential observation
scientific_decisions: Leaving one observation out and evaluating predictive cross-validation are different procedures; the intended statistic must be specified.

required_stages: pin publication and extract compound assay rows
apply endpoint, censoring and selectivity rules
resolve ties and selected structure identity
export canonical identity and supporting assay values
scientific_decisions: Values at assay limits require the stated censoring interpretation; never treat a reported bound as an exact potency.

required_stages: rank eligible biological targets
map the selected target to bioactivity records
select a measured compound under tie rules
search structural neighbors with explicit duplicate exclusions
scientific_decisions: The query compound, salts, isotopologues and stereoisomers can dominate similarity results unless the exclusion policy is defined.

required_stages: resolve literature entities to versioned transcript accessions
retrieve complete observed transcript sequences
run a pinned folding model with stated conditions
export transcript identities, lengths and predicted energies
scientific_decisions: Predicted free energy is a computational result; transcript selection, thermodynamic parameters and date consistency require validation.

required_stages: identify the experimentally supported candidate proteins
reconcile species and sequence isoforms
align sequences under a fixed method
rank identities with explicit denominators
scientific_decisions: Local/global alignment and identity denominators can change the ordering.

required_stages: freeze the exact patent publication
select compounds using measured assays and censoring rules
compute a common substructure under explicit graph matching options
export the structure and selection ledger
scientific_decisions: A maximum common substructure may be nonunique; define atom/bond matching, connection-point notation and acceptable alternatives.

required_stages: select eligible compounds and clinical targets
resolve canonical target sequences and species fallback
run a pinned affinity model
rank outputs with declared units and uncertainty limits
scientific_decisions: Frozen model scores are not observed affinities or evidence of efficacy/toxicity; model weights, units and deterministic inference remain to be inspected.

required_stages: select the donor cohort and expression libraries
fit a declared count model and identify upregulated precursors
screen cross-species homologs
join mature products and export sequence features with statistics
scientific_decisions: Raw and adjusted p-values differ; preserve donor replication, precursor-to-mature multiplicity, alignment denominator and source versions.

required_stages: join regions across independent cohorts
filter directional effects, uncertainty and complete performance data
intersect genomic annotations using a fixed assembly
join independent literature evidence and rank candidates
export accepted and rejected candidates
scientific_decisions: Preserve cohort independence, interval conventions and ranking order; diagnostic evidence needs specimen context and cannot be inferred from an overlap.

required_stages: extract alternative domain boundaries from publications
map each boundary convention to a versioned sequence and structure
aggregate per-residue prediction confidence
export all ranges and the selected sequence
scientific_decisions: Prediction confidence does not establish binding or biological activity; numbering offsets and inclusive boundaries must be resolved.

required_stages: join screen responses, viability and compound identities
exclude assay artifacts and contradictory pharmacology under explicit rules
join independent drug catalogs
export complete hit and exclusion tables
scientific_decisions: Cell death can mimic activity; missing or contradictory evidence must not silently become an active call.
